bundle.shortDescription: See what a transaction really does before you approve it.
bundle.longDescription: Reads a Safe transaction and says what those bytes actually do, from the bytes alone. It holds no keys and signs nothing; reviewing happens offline, and the only thing that reaches the network is fetching a queued transaction by its hash from Safe's service. Your hardware wallet still signs; this is the second pair of eyes.
